description: This is an Android activity class named ContentInfoActivity written in Kotlin. It manages a detailed content information screen for a TV app, displaying metadata, background, focusable action buttons, and system time/date. It includes methods for UI setup, content population from intent extras, focus animations, and button interactions.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for content detail UI with focus handling and system info display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup of activity, including UI components and focus.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Populates system date and time display.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Fills UI components with content data from intent extras.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes focusable action buttons with icons, labels, and event handlers.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Responds to button presses with scale animation and placeholder action handlers.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch ContentInfoActivity with specified content metadata.
